RLWalk launcher integration

The web console stores the selected filename in $HOME/policy/.active_policy. Install puddleduck_files/bin/walk.sh as $HOME/walk.sh, then replace the old test.sh action with:

actions:
  - name: RLWalk
    trigger: "start"
    mode: "long"
    cmd:
      - /home/duck/walk.sh
    cooldown_s: 0.5

walk.sh runs python -m pd.runtime.walk, resolves the selected file, changes to $HOME, and then replaces itself with RLWalk.

General settings, hardware, networks, actions, emotes, controller triggers, audio, controllers, updates, and diagnostics.

Duck identity

Friendly name used as the body Linux hostname, its .local address, and HTTPS site. Private body/head traffic continues to use the fixed bdx-body and bdx-head aliases from /etc/hosts; /etc/default/bdx-network is not changed.

Checking Orin power controls…

Press once to arm, then confirm within six seconds. Recovery places only the selected Orin in NVIDIA Force Recovery Mode for USB flashing. Shutdown powers off both Orins and leaves both Teensys in terminal low-power sleep. Power actions are refused while a policy is running.

Motor assignment and identification

Positions arrive in the normal state stream while monitoring is enabled. Move one relaxed joint by hand; the row with the greatest movement over the last few seconds is highlighted. Go1 and Dynamixel IDs can be physically changed here; Unitree A1 IDs remain a physical setup operation.
